units.source_text: 长生殿的故事是不祥的，所以不引用“比翼鸟”的典故[\[18\]](#part1333.html#m18)，

en.t: The story of the Hall of Everlasting Life was ill-omened, so he did not cite the allusion to the paired-wing birds[\[18\]](#part1333.html#m18),

units.source_text: 而誓愿同生在五十六亿七千万年之后弥勒菩萨出世之时。

en.t: but instead vowed that they would be born together when Maitreya Bodhisattva appears in the world five billion six hundred seventy million years from now.

units.source_text: 这盟约多么语重心长啊！

en.t: How solemn and deeply meaningful this pledge was!
